about: The only hooks a product's .claude/settings.json may carry (ENF-1): its SessionStart hook, and R17c's PreToolUse hooks (the pinned tool's GitHub pacing hook on every GitHub connector call and every Bash command, as notes/r17c-settings.md gives them). setup check's drift condition fails any other hook.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; f="$d/.process/tool/p3.mjs"; h="$d/.process/tool/hook.mjs"; cd "$d" || exit 2; if [ -f "$h" ]; then node "$h"; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2; fi; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "GitHub pacing hook: no tool at $f (the pin not filled yet): this call is not governed" >&2; exit 0; fi; if ! grep -q "'github hook'" "$f"; then echo "GitHub pacing hook: $f has no github hook (a pin from before R17c): this call is not governed" >&2; exit 0; fi; node "$f" github hook; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2
